reaction.episode: CORRECTION episode, data through the Nov 16 close: SPX 7,416.59 is 5.46% below its 120-day high, 3.2% below its 50-day and 1.01% above its 200-day; SMH $461.90 is below Zone 2 (31.25% drawdown, 11.88% below its 200-day); NVDA $156.14 is below Zone 2 (35.84% drawdown, RSI 22.7); VIX 22.91 is its 5-day high with no rollover; HY OAS 3.23 is calm; the mechanical tally is 1 of 4 (credit only).

ladder.response: Stand down all deployment; Tranche A preparation void until both are back below their lines.

reaction.trapRisk: The first bounce is the trap case: SMH is 31% off its high, NVDA's RSI is 22.7 (oversold) and TQQQ fell 7.66% today, so a sharp relief rally into the SPX $7,750-7,820 failure zone is likely and must not be chased. Entries wait for the failure-zone retest verdict and a second low that holds — never the first green day, and never on a VIX spike day.

strategyPosture: Watch. No new money: the mechanical tally is 1 of 4 (credit only), SMH $461.90 and NVDA $156.14 are both below their Zone 2 floors, VIX 22.91 is spiking without a rollover, and NVDA earnings Tue Nov 17 after the close is the next deciding print. Tranche A is not re-armed — only MU sits in Zone 2 at $719.02.

themes.counterRead: Credit says rotation, not rollover — but the divergence is widening and the tape is deteriorating: QQQ fell 2.54% today and 9.36% over three months. If lending standards flip, the rotation read breaks and the index-level calm stops masking anything.
themes.dataAnchor: Mag7 average is 18.56% below 52-week highs versus SPY at 5.3%, a 13.26-point divergence gap; weakest is NVDA at 35.8% below its high, strongest AAPL at 2.2%. Bank lending standards are LOOSE (SLOOS 1.7%, far below the ~40% stress threshold). QQQ is down 6.64% over the month while IWM is up 0.87% — the pain is concentrated in large-cap growth, not the broad market.
themes.label: Rotation, not rollover — index calm masks Mag7 weakness
themes.narrative: The index looks orderly: SPY fell 1.87% on the day and sits only 5.3% below its 52-week high, while the names that dominate it by weight are in a different market entirely.
themes.watchFor: SLOOS print above 10%, or the Mag7/SPY divergence gap widening past 20 points.

themes.counterRead: The setup is real but timing is not: NVDA reports Tue Nov 17 after the close, the first Kress-led call, and the circular-finance story is the overhang the revenue numbers do not answer. Fundamentals ahead of price is an opportunity only if the print confirms them — a miss turns the same names into the next leg down.
themes.dataAnchor: Revenue is still growing fast while prices fall: AVGO revenue +55% YoY at 32.6% below its high (score 81, tier A); DDOG +27.7% YoY with 80% gross margin and $1,001M free cash flow, 42.5% below its high (score 84, tier A); ONTO +41.5% YoY, 49.1% below its high (score 81); LRCX +131.3% YoY, 51.9% below its high (score 79); NVDA +61.4% YoY, 35.8% below its high with RSI 22.7 (oversold). MU is $719.02, 42.7% below its high and inside Zone 2 ($700-745).
themes.label: AI infrastructure: fundamentals ahead of price
themes.narrative: The market believes the AI build-out is over: NVDA is down 27.19% in a month, SMH is 31.25% below its high, and semiconductor names sit 40-50% below their peaks.
themes.watchFor: NVDA earnings Tue Nov 17 after close: print vs consensus, guidance, and any comment on the Enscale loans.

themes.counterRead: VST is a holding, not a new buy — the entry is still not armed, next leg the 50-day at $145.08. The trough signal (insider buying at the low) argues the drawdown is sentiment, but the theme needs a demand-side catalyst; without one the trough can extend and the insider buy can look early.
themes.dataAnchor: VST is $130.16, 31.2% below its peak with RSI 44.1, insiders bought $1.17M at the trough, conviction score 83; VRT is $188.67, 50.3% below its peak and is a holding. One-month laggards across the theme: CCJ -19.01%, SMR -26.59% (-8.15% today), OKLO -17.52%, URA -13.21%.
themes.label: Nuclear / AI power at the trough
themes.narrative: The nuclear/AI-power trade has unwound hard — the market now prices the power build-out as stalled.
themes.watchFor: VST reclaim of its 50-day $145.08 on a close; SMR/CCJ stabilization — two consecutive closes without new lows.

themes.counterRead: Credit calm plus VIX spiking is the 'correction, not crisis' pattern — until it is not. VIX above 25 trips the stand-down and HY OAS above 4% does the same; both are within one bad day of tripping, and the recent VIX misprints are a reminder to re-verify the print rather than trust the first number.
themes.dataAnchor: HY OAS 3.23 is below the 4% stand-down line and calm; the 2s10s curve is +0.27 (not inverted); real 10Y 2.95%; fed funds 3.88%. But VIX 22.91 jumped 18.7% today to its 5-day high with no rollover, up 24.24% over 20 days; SPX fell 1.92% today and is 5.46% below its 120-day high.
themes.label: Credit and rates calm, VIX spiking
themes.narrative: Rates and credit look calm — 10Y at 5.15%, high-yield spreads at 3.23 — so the market reads this as an orderly equity correction, not a credit event.
themes.watchFor: VIX close above 25 or HY OAS above 4% (stand-down); VIX rollover — a close below 20 after the spike.

themes.counterRead: The unwind is orderly so far — no forced-selling signature in the data, and BTC holding flat on a 1.87% SPY down day hints the crypto leg may be pausing. But TQQQ at $53.03 sits below the watcher's $54-57 deeper zone floor, so the leveraged book is where the pain concentrates if the correction extends.
themes.dataAnchor: TQQQ is down 21.92% over the month and 7.66% today to $53.03; CONL down 54.66% over the month and 11.34% today; BMNR down 24.47% over the month and 6.94% today (a holding, excluded from the ladder); BTC-USD down 18.3% over the month, ETH-USD down 21.18%, IBIT down 19.81% (-4.96% today), DOGE down 23.49% over the month, COIN down 30.5% over the month (-5.72% today). BTC was flat today (+0.07%) while equities fell — the first non-confirmation of the unwind.
themes.label: Leveraged and crypto complex unwinding together
themes.narrative: The leveraged complex is unwinding in unison — the market treats TQQQ, crypto proxies and leveraged single-stock ETFs as one risk bucket being sold together.
themes.watchFor: BTC: a second flat-to-up day while equities fall would confirm the crypto leg is pausing; a fresh -5% day re-opens the unwind. TQQQ close below $54 vs reclaim of $57.

whereWaveBuilds: The next move builds around NVDA earnings Tue Nov 17 after the close (first Kress-led call): a print that re-rates the AI complex pulls SMH back toward Zone 2 ($470-505) and tests the SPX failure zone $7,750-7,820; a miss accelerates the correction toward the SPX 200-day $7,342.71.
